description:
In the waning age of magic there lived "Tethys", the royal court sorcerer of the Belga Kingdom, and "Dima", a skilled wand craftsman.

While Dima never hid his affection, Tethys always met it with a teasing smile.

One day, a prodigiously powerful young sorcerer named "Enya" appeared in the kingdom. Fate would one day bind "Tethys" to "Enya"—through a wand crafted by "Dima"’s own hands.

This is the story of three, set in the Velga Kingdom, built upon the cliffs where the waves crash below.
